name: drill-footprint-refusal-visual
description: #1359: the Drill tool refuses holes under a building or construction site. Add Hole on a footprint tile shows the refused overlay and leaves Confirm disabled; a grid dragged across the footprint previews the skipped count, orders only the free cells, and the drill-notice status line reports the skip after Confirm.

steps.description: Setup: fresh staffed site with open ground around (16,16).
Player orders living quarters at (16,16) through the Build panel. A construction site counts as a footprint at once, so no wait for completion is needed.
Player opens Blast Workshop > Drill > Add Hole and picks the footprint tile (16,16). The overlay shows refused, the reason text shows in the strip, Confirm is disabled and no hole is ordered.

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:1 cols:5 spacing:3 depth:6 start:10,16
steps.description: Player cancels Add Hole, arms the Grid tool and drags across a row at z=16 from x=10 to x=22 (5 cells at spacing 3: 10,13,16,19,22). Preview shows the skipped count; Confirm orders only cells outside the footprint and the drill-notice line reports the skip.

expect.note: At least one of the 5 cells lies under the footprint, so fewer than 5 holes are ordered but at least one is.
